description: This is a shell script used in a Linux-based embedded system for device upgrade operations. It defines functions for performing device-specific upgrade procedures, image checks, and configuration copying based on the device model.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles the device upgrade process based on device model and image characteristics.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies the integrity and type of the device image before upgrade.
